questions.chapter: Chapter 1: Engineering Profession, Professional Bodies & Ethics
questions.text: Explain the Code of Ethics for Professional Engineers prescribed by the Nepal Engineering Council (NEC). Discuss ethical obligations towards the society, client, employer, profession, and fellow engineers. Explain Conflict of Interest with practical construction engineering examples.

questions.chapter: Chapter 1: Engineering Profession, Professional Bodies & Ethics
questions.text: Explain Professional Liability and Negligence in civil engineering design and supervision. What is Tort Liability and Contractual Liability? Explain Whistleblowing and ethical dilemmas when safety standards are compromised.

questions.chapter: Chapter 4: Environmental & Social Impact of Engineering Projects & Code of Conduct
questions.text: Explain the Social Impact Assessment (SIA) process for major infrastructure projects (Highways, Hydropower, Airports). Explain Land Acquisition, Compensation, Resettlement and Rehabilitation (R&R) frameworks, and Public Hearing mechanisms.

questions.chapter: Chapter 3: Technology, Society & Sustainable Development Goals
questions.text: Explain the Nepal Environment Protection Act and Rules. Differentiate between Initial Environmental Examination (IEE) and Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA). Explain Environmental Management Plan (EMP) and UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDG 6, 7, 9, 11, 13).

questions.chapter: Chapter 4: Environmental & Social Impact of Engineering Projects & Code of Conduct
questions.text: Explain Gender Equality and Social Inclusion (GESI) mainstreaming in infrastructure development projects. Discuss the Nepal Labor Act provisions regarding occupational health and safety, minimum wages, equal remuneration, and child labor prohibition.
